description: Persistent graph-native coordination of body/world sessions, active order-N goals, developmental plans/frontiers, existing motor hints/programs, counterfactual rehearsal, affordance-gated external trials, causal developmental receipts, integer learned consequences, receipt-grounded check-ins/reset rearming, and non-scalar Pareto evidence. All in-frame cognition is integer-native.

rules.name: els_carry_observed_support_topology_to_causal_receipt
rules.comment: The world measures WHICH links touch the ground; this rule decides what that means for the curriculum. Guarded on the evidence's own observation flag so an unread topology leaves the fields ABSENT instead of asserting an unchanged one.

rules.name: els_open_persistent_embodied_learning_session
rules.comment: The world boundary publishes body-schema and world tokens; a rule, not the adapter, decides that they constitute one durable learning session.

rules.name: els_bind_active_order_n_goal_plan_and_frontier
rules.comment: The session follows the developmental seed's selected step and capability frontier; order-N goal structure remains owned by the generic Goal graph.

rules.name: els_bind_existing_motor_hint_and_program
rules.comment: Motor priors and programs are produced by their own embodied seeds. The session records the selected pair without interpreting opaque actuator contents.

rules.name: els_request_counterfactual_trial_before_external_trial
rules.comment: The selected program is injected into detached cognition. Existing learned consequence attributes produce a projection there; the result is explicitly non-oracular and requires external validation.

rules.name: els_project_learned_motor_consequences_in_detached_cognition
rules.comment: This fires only in the detached graph because the live graph has no EmbodiedCounterfactualSelection. It reads the selected program's learned integer consequence model; it does not fabricate grounded success.

rules.name: els_retain_detached_motor_projection_as_non_oracular_evidence
rules.comment: The imagination dispatcher only publishes provenance. This graph rule closes the rehearsal while explicitly requiring a grounded external trial.

rules.name: els_request_grounded_external_trial_from_declared_affordances
rules.comment: Only an explicitly published pose affordance and the developmental seed's already-selected reset scenario can authorize a world trial. The adapter merely reads this request.

rules.name: els_project_full_grounded_displacement_vector_for_active_goal
rules.comment: The world adapter reports an entire measured displacement vector once. The graph, rather than the adapter or a six-way program clone, projects the integer vector into the current exploratory goal's movement evidence.

rules.name: els_retain_grounded_external_evidence_and_close_request
rules.comment: World evidence is first-class and is never inferred from a counterfactual result. Receipt publication is mechanical I/O; closure is a graph decision.

rules.name: els_publish_grounded_external_evidence_to_pareto_profile
rules.comment: Three measured integer coordinates remain distinct: goal progress, energy cost, and peak load. General cognitive_pareto decides dominance; no scalar reward is introduced.

rules.name: els_close_exact_external_trial_as_causal_development_receipt
rules.comment: Only exact externally grounded evidence with its request, program, pose, reset scenario, and goal provenance closes a developmental receipt. The same receipt updates integer consequence coordinates and experience; it is not a scalar reward.

rules.name: els_publish_receipt_grounded_developmental_evidence
rules.comment: The developmental DAG receives a receipt-grounded evidence object. A positive measured displacement contributes one integer capability success unit; non-progress remains retained evidence without laundering itself into success.

rules.name: els_count_positive_receipt_as_capability_success
rules.comment: MEASURED PROGRESS IS NOT A MET CRITERION. This counts the world's own positive goal progress (evidence.success_units == 1) into `positive_progress_count`, which mission confirmation reads. It must NOT touch `success_count`: that attribute means 'this capability's developmental criterion was satisfied' and is what mastery and retention are judged on. Once per published developmental evidence node.

rules.name: els_open_receipt_grounded_learning_checkin_and_reset_rearm
rules.comment: A closed receipt creates a graph-visible check-in and re-arms reset through the developmental scenario already used by the observed trial. The next program is still selected by the plan/Pareto machinery; no host cadence is introduced.
